endorsements.quote: Nurses in leadership or informatics roles must be equipped to critically evaluate AI tools and guide their responsible implementation in clinical settings.
Integrating AI into undergraduate curricula, covering how algorithms function, what data they rely on, and how to interpret their outputs is essential for the future nursing education and practice.

This includes providing protected time for digital experimentation, offering seed funding for nurse-led AI projects (such as AI Nurses Network 23 ), and formally recognising contributions to technological advancement.

unlisted_practices: Embed AI literacy into nursing curricula horizontally across clinical content areas and vertically from introductory to proficiency levels.
Offer nurses ongoing continuing professional development on AI at all professional levels.
Include nurses in the development, validation, implementation, and evaluation of AI tools, including as co-designers and decision-makers.
Represent nurses in AI governance, procurement decisions, ethics reviews, and algorithm evaluation and implementation committees.
Have professional bodies convene nursing voices to co-create national AI guidelines, position statements, protocols, and educational standards.
Clarify accountability for AI-influenced clinical decisions and how systems will log, audit, and respond to AI-related adverse events.
Embed fairness as an operational principle in AI oversight, such as through the BE FAIR initiative.
Adapt AI implementation to local contexts, including low- and middle-income countries, considering digital infrastructure, workforce capacity, and cultural sensitivity.
Nurses should publish evaluations and share AI experiences and outcomes through research, peer learning, and communities of practice.
Support nurse educators to keep current with AI capabilities and limitations.
Address over-reliance, academic integrity, and ethical AI use in nursing education.

screen.reason: This commentary presents the APDDS framework outlining recommendations and strategic approaches for integrating AI across nursing practice, education, research, and policy.
